title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-08-04
summary: Weekly standup + research notes: quantization experiments, eval regressions, onboarding two new open models (mistral-lite and phoenix-7B). Action items for infra and eval infra fixes.
content:
Attendees: Ava, Samir, Lina, Jordi, Priya (infra sync)
Date: 2026-08-04

High-level:
- Focus this week: (1) finalize 4-bit quant pipeline for Llama-family and test on phoenix-7B; (2) root-cause eval regressions seen in regression-suite v2 for chat and summarization; (3) finish onboarding checklist for mistral-lite and submit perf-profile to model-catalog.
- Status: experiments running, some flaky evals due to dataset sharding bug in eval infra. Infra triage in progress.

Standup notes / day-by-day:
Mon (8/3):
- Samir: baseline 4-bit PTQ pipeline implemented (quantize + KF16 emulation), initial runs on decoder-only 7B. Observed ~1.9x throughput improvement, latency variance increased for long prompts. Saving logs to s3://redwood-ml/quant/2026-08-03/.
- Lina: started regression triage on summarization tests; saw 3 failing prompts where model hallucinates dates. Suspect tokenization mismatch after merging new tokenizer fix in repo. Opened JIRA-ML-789.
- Ava: updated onboarding checklist draft for mistral-lite (see linked PR). Need final perf metrics and compatibility notes for KV cache layout.

Tue (8/4):
- Jordi: ran end-to-end eval on phoenix-7B quantized to 4-bit with QK-optimized kernels. Quality drop ~0.8 BLEU (on internal reranking task) compared to FP16 baseline; still within acceptable QA thresholds for dev tier but flagged for prod.
- Infra (Priya): identified eval infra sharding bug where some test shards were not being seeded consistently across runs -> nondeterministic failures. Hotfix in staging, will deploy tomorrow.
- Team sync: agreed to hold back prod rollout of phoenix-7B quant until we have stable eval runs (3 consecutive successes across regression-suite v2).

Key research updates:
1) Quantization experiments
- Approach: mix of PTQ with per-channel symmetric quant for weights + outlier-aware activations (clamp & remap). Using calibration set of 2k representative queries (from production traces, anonymized).
- Kernels: testing two optimized kernels: qk-amp-vec (works well for short context) and qk-chunked (better long context throughput). qk-chunked gives better tail latency at batch sizes >8.
- Results summary (decoder-only 7B / phoenix-7B):
  - 4-bit PTQ w/ blocked per-channel: throughput +1.8-2.1x, memory -48%, loss in Rouge-L ~0.6-1.2 pts depending on task.
  - 8-bit quant baseline: +1.2x throughput, minimal quality drop.
  - Observed regression patterns in instruction-following tasks for phoenix-7B at very low-temp sampling; hypothesis: activation clipping affects low-prob mass for stop-sequences.
- Next steps: run 8-shot calibration experiments, try outlier-slicing (exclude top-0.1% activations) and re-run evals.

2) Evals / regression-suite v2
- Problem: nondeterministic failures traced to shard-seed bug (infra). Also saw tokenizer change in repo causing mismatch in expected token boundaries -> hallucination cases.
- Action: infra deploying hotfix; Samir to re-run full regression-suite after deploy. Lina to create reduced failing set for manual inspection and to write targeted tests.
- Metrics to track: Rouge-L, BLEU, Chat-turn consistency, hallucination rate (binary flag), P0 latency.

3) Model onboarding (mistral-lite, phoenix-7B)
- Mistral-lite: low-memory variant, currently passes functional tests in FP16; need to produce perf-profile with 4-bit/8-bit quant configs. Onboarding checklist items left: (a) KV cache layout doc, (b) tokenizer edge-cases, (c) model card + license verification.
- Phoenix-7B: already in catalog as FP16. Quantized variant blocked until eval stability. Need per-route cost estimate for hosted API.
- Documentation: Ava to update model-catalog entry with caveats about instruction-tuning artifacts and recommended defaults for temperature/top_p.

Open issues / risks:
- Eval infra stability is a blocker for any prod rollouts this sprint.
- Quant quality drop for some instruction-following cases may require mixed-precision fallback for critical routes.
- Tokenizer change in main repo introduced edge-case for date formatting -> risk for downstream summarization customers. Need urgent test coverage.

Action items (owners):
- Priya (infra): deploy regression-suite shard-seed hotfix to staging by 8/05. Add deterministic-seed flag to CI. (blocked: deployment window)
- Samir (applied-ml): re-run regression-suite v2 on phoenix-7B 4-bit once infra fix is live; collect full logs and set up a diff-run vs FP16. Target 8/06.
- Lina (evals): extract minimal failing prompt set and create unit tests (Jest + python harness) for tokenizer edge cases. Target 8/05.
- Ava (model-onboarding): finalize mistral-lite perf-profile doc and submit model-catalog PR. Add recommended fallback policy for instruction routes. Target 8/07.
- Jordi (research): run outlier-slicing experiments and 8-shot calibration; upload metrics to s3 and add summary table to confluence. Target 8/08.

Notes to self / rough brainstorm
- Consider adaptive fallback: for critical customer routes, do quick FP16 verification for first N tokens then switch to quantized path if no triggers. Complexity: double compute for N tokens but could reduce hallucination risk.
- Evaluate cost benefit for qk-chunked vs dynamic batching on dedicated pools; might be better to tune batch-size SLOs per model variant.
- Need a small benchmark harness to reproduce the tokenizer date hallucination deterministically (include locale variations).

Links & artifacts
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quantization/pull/214
- JIRA: JIRA-ML-789 (tokenizer mismatch + hallucination)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-ML/quant-profiles
- S3 logs: s3://redwood-ml/quant/2026-08-03/

Meeting notes appended (quick):
- Quick infra sync: Priya: rolling deploy plan approved, will throttle to 2 clusters at a time.
- Product ask: Sales requested perf numbers for mistral-lite by 8/12 for prospective trial customer.

Next weekly goals (8/11):
- Stable regression-suite runs (3 consecutive) for phoenix-7B quantized variant.
- Mistral-lite perf-profile + catalog entry merged.
- Decision on mixed-precision fallback strategy for production routes.

Signed: Ava (on behalf of applied-ml)
